Mina (People Ops): Quick idea 10-min ask: run a 'Spark Station' pilot the week of June 7. Think: small table with sticky notes, pre-printed mini recognition cards, and a $12 local lunch voucher for remote folks. Purpose: low-friction peer shoutouts + micro treats. Volunteers?
Devin: love this. In-person only or hybrid?
Mina (People Ops): Hybrid. In-office pop-ups + a digital card PDF + e-gift for remote.
Asha: I can take the NYC pop-up. I have a nearby print shop that does 200 postcard-size prints same-day.
Marco: I can do SF logistics and order the sticker sheets. Are we doing envelopes?
Mina (People Ops): No envelopes for the pop-up cards (we want them quick to hand out). Envelopes for mailed extras only if requested. Target counts: SF 90, NYC 120, Remote allotment 60.
Jules: Timeline?
Mina (People Ops): Proposed timeline:
```
- May 20: confirm volunteers + city leads
- May 24: finalize card art and sticker set
- May 28: place print + sticker orders
- Week of Jun 7: pop-up days (1 day per office)
- Jun 10: remote e-gifts + PDF send
```
Devin: Who's handling the vendor POs? I can submit via procurement if we have receipts.
Asha: I will get quotes for printing and sticker pack. Expect ~$0.45/card (double-sided), stickers $1.25 each pack, lunch voucher $12. That puts kits around $13 before misc.
Marco: Facilities question: can we reserve the main foyer table for a 3-hour slot in SF?
FacilitiesBot: Please submit a facilities reservation request at least 72 hours in advance. Use the portal to secure space.
Devin: I'll coordinate volunteer shifts (2 people per pop-up: setup & run).
Mina (People Ops): Awesome. Volunteers so far: Asha (NYC pop-up + vendor contact), Marco (SF logistics + stickers), Devin (volunteer scheduling & procurement), Mina (design, remote e-gift send).
Asha: Ill post printing quotes here by EOD Thursday. Also can source mini pens for write-station.
Jules: For remote, can we do a short form so recipients can request a physical kit?
Mina (People Ops): Yes 100% 1 will add a quick Google form (name, office, remote? physical kit address).
Marco: Suggestion: add a tiny "how to" card encouraging specific praise (1-2 sentences) to keep notes meaningful.
Mina (People Ops): Love that. Short prompt on the back: "What did they do? What impact?"
Devin: OK to tag #random with a photo of the pop-up?
Mina (People Ops): Please do tag #random and drop a short blurb in the weekly digest.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder: deliveries must be scheduled via the portal. Vendors dropping off >10 boxes require a freight elevator booking.
Mina (People Ops): Final action items recap: Asha to secure printing quote + pens, Marco to reserve SF table & stickers, Devin to create volunteer schedule + procurement ticket, Mina to finalize art + Google form + remote vouchers. I'll update this thread with the Google form link and final counts. Thanks all :sparkles:
